claims.claim: **Intralesional therapy means injecting a corticosteroid, usually triamcinolone acetonide, straight into a lesion** in or just under the skin.
claims.locator: DermNet (Lin C-Y, Waikato Hospital), New Zealand, 'Intralesional steroid injection', 2012, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/intralesional-steroid-injection, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Products:** triamcinolone comes in 2 strengths, 10 mg/mL and 40 mg/mL (Kenacort-A 10 and Kenacort-A 40); betamethasone injection is Celestone Chronodose (1 mL).
claims.locator: DermNet (Lin C-Y, Waikato Hospital), New Zealand, 'Intralesional steroid injection', 2012, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/intralesional-steroid-injection, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Indications include** keloids and hypertrophic scars; hypertrophic lichen planus; lichen simplex chronicus; necrobiosis lipoidica; granuloma annulare and other granulomatous disease (cutaneous sarcoidosis, granuloma faciale); discoid lupus; alopecia areata; localised psoriasis; and inflamed acne or epidermoid cysts.
claims.locator: DermNet (Lin C-Y, Waikato Hospital), New Zealand, 'Intralesional steroid injection', 2012, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/intralesional-steroid-injection, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Why inject rather than apply?** It goes past a thick stratum corneum, gives a higher concentration where the dermal inflammation is, and is less likely than a topical steroid to thin the epidermis.
claims.locator: DermNet (Lin C-Y, Waikato Hospital), New Zealand, 'Intralesional steroid injection', 2012, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/intralesional-steroid-injection, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Do not inject into actively infected skin** (such as impetigo or herpes simplex), or when the patient is allergic to triamcinolone.
claims.locator: DermNet (Lin C-Y, Waikato Hospital), New Zealand, 'Intralesional steroid injection', 2012, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/intralesional-steroid-injection, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Clean the site with alcohol or antiseptic and inject with a fine needle into the dermis, not the fat,** to avoid leaving a dent.
claims.locator: DermNet (Lin C-Y, Waikato Hospital), New Zealand, 'Intralesional steroid injection', 2012, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/intralesional-steroid-injection, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Volume: about 0.1–0.2 mL per cm² of affected skin, usually no more than 1–2 mL in total per session,** repeated every 4–8 weeks.
claims.locator: DermNet (Lin C-Y, Waikato Hospital), New Zealand, 'Intralesional steroid injection', 2012, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/intralesional-steroid-injection, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Use it at full strength or thinned** with saline or a local anaesthetic.
claims.locator: DermNet (Lin C-Y, Waikato Hospital), New Zealand, 'Intralesional steroid injection', 2012, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/intralesional-steroid-injection, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Typical triamcinolone strengths:** 40 mg/mL for a thick keloid; 10 mg/mL for a moderately thick hypertrophic scar; 10 mg/mL for discoid lupus or granuloma annulare.
claims.locator: DermNet (Lin C-Y, Waikato Hospital), New Zealand, 'Intralesional steroid injection', 2012, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/intralesional-steroid-injection, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Injections can be given each month, for several months, as long as the disease is active.**
claims.locator: DermNet (Lin C-Y, Waikato Hospital), New Zealand, 'Intralesional steroid injection', 2012, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/intralesional-steroid-injection, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Early effects usually settle:** pain, bleeding, bruising, infection, contact allergy to the benzyl alcohol preservative, poor wound healing and sterile abscess (sometimes needing drainage).
claims.locator: DermNet (Lin C-Y, Waikato Hospital), New Zealand, 'Intralesional steroid injection', 2012, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/intralesional-steroid-injection, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Warn about delayed effects:** fat atrophy with dimpling (the commonest, and possibly permanent), pale or dark marks that may persist, telangiectasia (treatable with laser or IPL), local hair growth and steroid acne.
claims.locator: DermNet (Lin C-Y, Waikato Hospital), New Zealand, 'Intralesional steroid injection', 2012, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/intralesional-steroid-injection, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Systemic effects are unlikely at intralesional doses,** which are very small. Allergic reactions, including anaphylaxis, are very rare and not dose-related.
claims.locator: DermNet (Lin C-Y, Waikato Hospital), New Zealand, 'Intralesional steroid injection', 2012, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/intralesional-steroid-injection, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Large intramuscular doses of triamcinolone have caused serious systemic harm,** and periocular injection has rarely been linked with blindness, as well as glaucoma and cataract.
claims.locator: DermNet (Lin C-Y, Waikato Hospital), New Zealand, 'Intralesional steroid injection', 2012, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/intralesional-steroid-injection, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Triamcinolone is sometimes given intramuscularly instead, as a systemic steroid:** typically 0.5–1 mg/kg (40–80 mg in an adult), repeatable every 30 days for 3–6 months.
claims.locator: DermNet (Lin C-Y, Waikato Hospital), New Zealand, 'Intralesional steroid injection', 2012, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/intralesional-steroid-injection, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Avoid systemic-dose triamcinolone** in active TB or systemic fungal infection; extensive plaque, pustular or erythrodermic psoriasis (it may destabilise it); active peptic ulcer; uncontrolled diabetes, heart failure or severe hypertension; and severe depression or psychosis.
claims.locator: DermNet (Lin C-Y, Waikato Hospital), New Zealand, 'Intralesional steroid injection', 2012, https://dermnetnz.org/topics/intralesional-steroid-injection, retrieved 2026-09-23
